title: Enshrouded server settings
description: User-editable keys of enshrouded_server.json (server version 0.9.0.0). Paths, ip and queryPort are controller-owned.

name.title: Server name
name.description: Name of the server as shown in the server list. All players can see it, so keep it non-offensive.

slotCount.title: Player slots
slotCount.description: Number of available player slots (1-16). Each slot increases server load.

voiceChatMode.title: Voice chat mode
voiceChatMode.description: Proximity voice chat or global, server-wide voice chat.

enableVoiceChat.title: Voice chat
enableVoiceChat.description: Switches voice chat completely off or on.

enableTextChat.title: Text chat
enableTextChat.description: Switches text chat completely off or on.

gameSettingsPreset.title: Difficulty preset
gameSettingsPreset.description: Difficulty preset. Default is vanilla, Relaxed fewer enemies and more loot, Hard more and more aggressive enemies, Survival adds survival mechanics, Custom enables gameSettings.

gameSettings.title: Custom game settings
gameSettings.description: Individual gameplay settings. Only applied by the server when gameSettingsPreset is Custom.

playerHealthFactor.title: Player health
playerHealthFactor.description: Scales the max health for players by a factor. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

playerManaFactor.title: Player mana
playerManaFactor.description: Scales the max mana for players by a factor. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

playerStaminaFactor.title: Player stamina
playerStaminaFactor.description: Scales the max stamina for players by a factor. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

playerBodyHeatFactor.title: Body heat against cold
playerBodyHeatFactor.description: Scales the max body heat; the higher the factor the longer a player can stay in very cold areas before hypothermia sets in.

playerDivingTimeFactor.title: Diving time
playerDivingTimeFactor.description: Modifies the initial amount of oxygen for players and therefore the time available underwater.

enableDurability.title: Weapon durability
enableDurability.description: If false, weapons don't break anymore.

enableStarvingDebuff.title: Hunger and starvation
enableStarvingDebuff.description: Enables hunger and starvation. During starvation the player loses health periodically until death if no food or drink is consumed.

foodBuffDurationFactor.title: Food buff duration
foodBuffDurationFactor.description: Scales food buff durations. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

fromHungerToStarving.title: Hungry state duration
fromHungerToStarving.description: Length of the hungry state before starving sets in (5 to 20 minutes). Unit is nanoseconds.

shroudTimeFactor.title: Shroud time
shroudTimeFactor.description: Scales how long player characters can remain within the Shroud. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

tombstoneMode.title: Tombstone mode
tombstoneMode.description: What players lose into a tombstone when dying; by default only materials.

enableGliderTurbulences.title: Glider turbulences
enableGliderTurbulences.description: If false, the glider is not affected by air turbulences, as in previous game versions.

weatherFrequency.title: Weather frequency
weatherFrequency.description: How often new weather phenomena appear in the game world.

fishingDifficulty.title: Fishing difficulty
fishingDifficulty.description: Strength of the fish during the fishing minigame; stronger fish make the minigame last longer.

miningDamageFactor.title: Mining effectiveness
miningDamageFactor.description: Scales mining damage. Higher values mean more terraforming and more resources per hit. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

plantGrowthSpeedFactor.title: Plant growth speed
plantGrowthSpeedFactor.description: Scales the plant growth speed. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

resourceDropStackAmountFactor.title: Resource gain
resourceDropStackAmountFactor.description: Scales the amount of materials per loot stack in chests, defeated enemies etc. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

factoryProductionSpeedFactor.title: Workstation effectiveness
factoryProductionSpeedFactor.description: Scales the length of production times for workshop items. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

perkUpgradeRecyclingFactor.title: Weapon recycling yield
perkUpgradeRecyclingFactor.description: Scales the amount of Runes returned when salvaging upgraded weapons. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

perkCostFactor.title: Weapon upgrade cost
perkCostFactor.description: Scales the amount of Runes required for upgrading weapons. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

experienceCombatFactor.title: Combat experience
experienceCombatFactor.description: Scales the amount of XP received through combat. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

experienceMiningFactor.title: Mining experience
experienceMiningFactor.description: Scales the amount of XP received by mining resources. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

experienceExplorationQuestsFactor.title: Exploration experience
experienceExplorationQuestsFactor.description: Scales the amount of XP received by exploring and completing quests. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

randomSpawnerAmount.title: Enemy amount
randomSpawnerAmount.description: Controls the amount of enemies in the world.

aggroPoolAmount.title: Simultaneous enemy attacks
aggroPoolAmount.description: Controls how many enemies are allowed to attack at the same time.

enemyDamageFactor.title: Enemy damage
enemyDamageFactor.description: Scales all enemy damage, except for bosses. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

enemyHealthFactor.title: Enemy health
enemyHealthFactor.description: Scales all enemy health, except for bosses. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

enemyStaminaFactor.title: Enemy stun resistance
enemyStaminaFactor.description: Scales all enemy stamina; enemies with more stamina take longer to stun. Excludes bosses. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

enemyPerceptionRangeFactor.title: Enemy perception
enemyPerceptionRangeFactor.description: Scales how far enemies can see and hear the player. Excludes bosses. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

bossDamageFactor.title: Boss damage
bossDamageFactor.description: Scales the damage of boss attacks. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

bossHealthFactor.title: Boss health
bossHealthFactor.description: Scales all health of bosses. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

threatBonus.title: Enemy attack frequency
threatBonus.description: Scales the frequency of enemy attacks. Excludes bosses. Ingame, the factor is represented by a percentage.

pacifyAllEnemies.title: Pacified enemies
pacifyAllEnemies.description: If true, enemies won't attack players until attacked. Excludes bosses.

tamingStartleRepercussion.title: Taming failure
tamingStartleRepercussion.description: How the game reacts when the player startles wildlife during taming.

dayTimeDuration.title: Daytime length
dayTimeDuration.description: Length of daytime; a smaller value means shorter daytime (2 to 60 minutes). Unit is nanoseconds.

nightTimeDuration.title: Nighttime length
nightTimeDuration.description: Length of nighttime; a smaller value means shorter nighttime (2 to 60 minutes). Unit is nanoseconds.

curseModifier.title: Shroud curse
curseModifier.description: Easy turns the Shroud curse off, Hard doubles the chance of receiving it relative to Normal.

userGroups.title: User groups
userGroups.description: Permission groups, each protected by a password. Group names must be unique (not enforceable in the schema; the controller checks). Passwords are secrets.

name.title: Group name
name.description: Name of the group; must be unique within userGroups.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password players enter to join this group. Generated at instance creation.

canKickBan.title: Can kick/ban
canKickBan.description: Members may kick and ban players.

canAccessInventories.title: Can access inventories
canAccessInventories.description: Members may access chests and other inventories.

canEditWorld.title: Can edit world
canEditWorld.description: Members may edit the world (terraform, gather).

reservedSlots.title: Reserved slots
reservedSlots.description: Player slots reserved for this group.
